label: 测试版

notes.zh:
云上小屋 1.6.0 测试版
· 新增单机牧场：小家旁多了一座牧场岛，有奶牛、鸡、鸭、羊，带棚舍、圈门和木桥，动物白天活动、晚上回棚睡觉
· 小家家具都能拿起来重新摆放，还加了几件新家具；衣柜、抽屉、床头柜等可以存放东西
· 新增床头灯和阅读灯，可以拿着走，也能单独开关
· 手里拿饲料，动物会跟着你走（鸡鸭跟种子，牛羊跟苹果）；对着动物按 N 可以给它起名字
· 剪羊毛：对着长毛羊按 E，掉下的羊毛能捡、能摆、能收纳，羊毛 6 天长回来
· 拍照模式：F6 进入或退出，F2 保存高清照片，F3 显示或隐藏名字牌
· 修复车辆开上牧场步桥、摆放虚影、删除提示和动物在院门卡住等问题
notes.en:
Cloud Cabin 1.6.0 Beta
· New single-player ranch: a ranch island next to your home with cows, chickens, ducks and sheep, barns, pen gates and a wooden bridge. Animals roam by day and sleep in their barns at night
· All home furniture can be picked up and rearranged, plus a few new pieces; wardrobes, drawers and nightstands can store items
· New bedside lamp and reading lamp you can carry and switch on or off
· Hold feed and animals follow you (chickens and ducks like seeds, cows and sheep like apples); press N at an animal to name it
· Sheep shearing: press E at a woolly sheep; the wool can be picked up, placed and stored, and grows back in 6 days
· Photo mode: F6 to enter or exit, F2 to save a high-res photo, F3 to show or hide name tags
· Fixed vehicles driving onto the ranch footbridge, placement ghosts, delete prompts and animals getting stuck at the yard gate
